+    url = QUrl("https://blocked.example.com/")
 
     host_blocker = host_blocker_factory()
     host_blocker._blocked_hosts.add(url.host())

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('block_source', ['runtime', 'config'])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('request_url, blocked', [
+    ('https://example.com/', True),
+    ('https://sub.example.com/path', True),
+    ('https://a.b.example.com/path', True),
+    ('https://a.b.example.com./path', True),
+    ('https://anotherexample.com/', False),
+])
+def test_parent_domain_blocking(
+    config_stub, host_blocker_factory, block_source, request_url, blocked
+):
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.method = 'hosts'
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.enabled = True
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.whitelist = []
+    blocker = host_blocker_factory()
+    target = (blocker._blocked_hosts if block_source == 'runtime'
+              else blocker._config_blocked_hosts)
+    target.add('example.com')
+
+    assert blocker._is_blocked(QUrl(request_url)) is blocked
+
+
+def test_parent_domain_whitelist_and_disabled(config_stub, host_blocker_factory):
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.method = 'hosts'
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.enabled = True
+    config_stub.val.content.blocking.whitelist = ['https://allowed.example.com/*']
+    blocker = host_blocker_factory()
+    blocker._blocked_hosts.add('example.com')
+
+    assert not blocker._is_blocked(QUrl('https://allowed.example.com/path'))
+    assert blocker._is_blocked(QUrl('https://other.example.com/path'))
+
+    first_party = QUrl('https://first-party.example.org/')
+    config_stub.set_obj('content.blocking.enabled', False,
+                        pattern=urlmatch.UrlPattern(first_party.toString()))
+    assert not blocker._is_blocked(QUrl('https://other.example.com/path'),
+                                   first_party_url=first_party)
+
+
 def test_no_blocklist_update(config_stub, download_stub, host_blocker_factory):
     """Ensure no URL is blocked when no block list exists."""
     config_stub.val.content.blocking.hosts.lists = None
